description: This file defines a React functional component 'SearchBar' for a search input UI with suggestion handling, keyboard navigation, and focus management, used within the Mattermost web application.

classes.name: SearchBar
classes.description: React functional component implementing a search bar with suggestion list, keyboard navigation, and focus control.

methods.name: useEffect
methods.description: React hook for side effects related to focus management based on 'isFocused' and 'keepFocused' props.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles keyboard events for navigation, selection, and clearing search input.

methods.name: getSearch
methods.description: Assigns the suggestion box component reference and optionally triggers focus callback.
